description: Resolve JMA areas and inspect official forecasts, warnings and uncertain typhoon tracks.

tools.name: areas_search
tools.description: Search source names and IDs with bounded local pagination.

tools.name: forecast_get
tools.description: Resolve an area and retrieve its district forecast. Required: area (default: 130000). Returns array.

params.name: area
params.description: JMA office or resolved district identifier

tools.name: typhoons_get
tools.description: Coherent cyclone forecast and intensity detail. Required: id (default: TC2632). Returns array.

params.name: id
params.description: JMA tropical cyclone canonical source identifier

tools.name: typhoons_list
tools.description: List active cyclones without detail requests. Returns array.

tools.name: warnings_get
tools.description: Current r8 municipality warning product bulletins. Required: area (default: 130000). Returns array.

params.name: area
params.description: JMA office or resolved municipality identifier

novel_features.description: Resolve source IDs and reject ambiguous destination names.

novel_features.name: Warning completeness
novel_features.description: Separate applicable no-warning, not-applicable, lifted and incomplete source records.

novel_features.name: Coherent cyclone detail
novel_features.description: Join matching JMA issued/valid-time geometry and intensity documents.

novel_features.name: Lazy cyclone discovery
novel_features.description: Discover current source cyclone IDs without detail requests.

novel_features.description: Validate first-party source catalogs before atomic local replacement.
